def get_y(x):
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        x0, y0 = pts[i]
        x1, y1 = pts[i+1]
        if x0 <= x <= x1:
            if x1 == x0:
                return y0
            return y0 + (y1 - y0) * (x - x0) / (x1 - x0)
    return None

    xa = active_pts[i]
    xb = active_pts[i+1]
    ya = get_y(xa)
    yb = get_y(xb)
    integral += (ya + yb) * (xb - xa) / 2.0
result = round(integral, 2)
